priceDisplay.modeHelpText: Decides which price customers of this group see and which stored price value the calculation is based on.
priceDisplay.modeGrossDescription: Customers see the stored gross price. The tax of their country is already part of it, so your net proceeds change from country to country.
priceDisplay.modeNetDescription: Customers see the stored net price and pay the tax of their country on top of it.
priceDisplay.modeGrossNetBaseLabel: Gross prices with net price base
priceDisplay.modeGrossNetBaseDescription: Customers see a gross price that is derived from the stored net price and the tax rate of their country. You always earn the net price, manually maintained gross prices are not used.

preview.intro: Example for a product with a net price of {netPrice} and a stored gross price of {grossPrice}.
preview.hintGross: The gross price is the same in every country (highlighted in green), so your net proceeds shrink as the tax rate rises (highlighted in yellow).
preview.hintNet: The tax is added on top of the net price, so your net proceeds are the same in every country (highlighted in green) while the amount the customer pays differs (highlighted in yellow).
preview.hintGrossNetBase: The gross price is derived per country from the net price, so customers still see gross prices (highlighted in yellow) while your net proceeds stay the same everywhere (highlighted in green).
